title: Spatial domain selection changes regional stromal expression contrasts in colorectal cancer Visium data
description: Analysis code for regional stromal expression comparisons in 22 colorectal cancer Visium sections from 12 patients. Includes original-data acquisition and domain-fitting scripts, saved publication maps, regional statistics, spatial sensitivity analyses, known-boundary simulations, muscle-marker summaries and readout-gene withholding. The scientific workflow generates Figures 1–3 and S1–S8, Table 1 and Tables S1–S16. A Colab notebook supports new fits from original counts; saved maps retain the specific fits examined in the study.
